_about: Shared upload PR 1: golden pins of today's upload decisions on the web and the phone (no behaviour change).
and ios/HealthRoadmapTests/UploadDecisionPinsTests.swift (copied into the test bundle by ios/scripts/build-engine.mjs).
Each row holds the verdict on each client. Where they differ, `decision` names the survey's D-number and `changedBy` the
later PR that may change it; until then the row stays as it is. A move into health-core keeps every row green, unedited.
A name is a string, or a list of pieces where {"repeat": c, "times": n} stands for n copies of c.

limits._note: Bytes and counts each client reads with today. D8: the phone takes a 20 MB ZIP, the web 10 MB (changedBy: PR 3 keeps it; the size is a product call).

fileKinds._note: A picked file (not inside a ZIP), by name alone. web: which reader opens it (pdf, image, docx, zip), legacyDoc (its own notice) or refused. phone: kept (a PDF or picture reader opens it), zip, or unsupported.
